description: Convert an MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV or AVI video (base64, max 15 MB) into an animated GIF with a two-pass colour palette. Trim by start and length (up to 30 s), set width, frames per second, speed, centre crop (square, vertical, wide), loop count, reverse or boomerang. maxSizeMb re-makes the GIF smaller (width, then frames/s, then colours) until it fits, and the response says what was reduced. Deterministic local ffmpeg, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.004/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/mp4-to-gif.

boomerang.description: Forward then backward (uses up to 10 s, 480 px)

crop.description: Centre crop: keep, square 1:1, vertical 9:16 or wide 16:9

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded video: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV or AVI (max 15 MB; empty = built-in 3-second sample MP4)

fileName.description: Optional file name, e.g. clip.mp4 (the GIF gets the same name)

fps.description: Frames per second (lowered automatically when a GIF would exceed 360 frames)

length.description: Seconds of video to use, max 30 (empty = to the end of the video)

maxSizeMb.description: Largest GIF size in MB, 0.2 to 10. The GIF is re-made smaller until it fits

quality.description: Colours and dithering: best (256, smooth), balanced (256), small (128), tiny (64)

reverse.description: Play backwards (uses up to 10 s, 480 px)

speed.description: Playback speed: 0.5 slow motion, 2 or 4 fast

start.description: Where the GIF starts: seconds (12.5) or mm:ss (0:12)

width.description: GIF width in pixels, never upscaled (orig = source width up to 800)

name: mp4_to_gif
title: MP4 to GIF API - convert video to an animated GIF that fits a size limit
